title: Re-seat a pedal bin's inner bucket that was put back turned, so the lid shuts
justification: Janitors and building cleaners held about 2.4 million US jobs in 2025 (BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook), and gathering and emptying trash is a listed core duty. Emptying a reusable inner bucket includes returning it to working condition. This task represents a round pedal-bin design whose bucket rim has a notch for the internal lift-rod guide. A quarter-turn error leaves the insert resting on that guide and the lid visibly ajar. Recovery combines opening the gravity lid with raising, turning and reseating the insert through a close bore. Source: https://www.bls.gov/ooh/building-and-grounds-cleaning/janitors-and-building-cleaners.htm
fault: The inner bucket starts turned 90 degrees from its key. Its back rim rests on a guide 11 mm above its normal underside, leaving the insert tilted roughly 3 degrees and the gravity lid roughly 9 degrees open. Its wire bail lies folded flat.
instruction: The lid of this pedal bin won't shut. Fix it so the bin closes properly.
objects: Current implementation: loose 25 cm diameter stainless pedal-bin body, rim 27.5 cm above bench, mass 2.2 kg; 25.6 cm diameter domed hinged lid, 0.4 kg, damped to close by gravity; 9 x 5 cm sprung pedal; fixed lift-rod guide 2 cm wide, projecting 11 mm inward, top at 26.6 cm. Grey polypropylene bucket 25 cm tall, tapered 20.4 to 21.1 cm diameter, 22.9 cm rim band with 4 x 2 cm notch; bucket 0.30 kg plus freely hinged 0.06 kg wire bail with 9 cm long, 18 mm diameter grip. Bin centre (0.32,0.03) m. SimReady glove box (0.50,-0.30), size (0.178,0.117,0.056), 0.35 kg; SimReady disinfectant bottle (0.30,-0.25), size (0.045,0.067,0.191), 0.50 kg. All rest on bench.
skill: An available method holds the pedal while the other hand raises the bail, lifts and turns the insert, lowers its notch round the guide, and folds the bail before releasing the pedal. Safe alternative strategies are permitted; bimanual necessity is an empirical question for red-team tests.
scoring: Final: insert base within 3 mm of its seated height, horizontal offset at most 8 mm, relative tilt at most 2 degrees, notch yaw within 15 degrees of the guide; hands at least 3 cm clear; bin and bucket linear speed at most 1 cm/s, angular speed at most 2 deg/s, lid angular speed at most 2 deg/s for 1 second. 1.0 if these hold and lid within 0.2 degrees of closed stop; 0.5 if insert seated but lid open; 0 otherwise. Entire run is zero if bin or insert base falls more than 5 cm below bench. Harmless temporary movement and safe alternative solutions are allowed.
nearest: 'Put a can in a pedal bin whose lid is blocked by the counter it is pushed under' (closed/withdrawn); 'Take out the trash: cinch and remove a loaded bin liner' (pending); 'Sort Household Waste into Lidded Bins and Close Them' (rejected). For holding something open while working: 'Hand a drink out a self-closing drive-thru window' (pending). None of these re-seats a keyed inner bucket under a gravity lid. RoboCasa and BEHAVIOR throw things into bins but never service the bin's insert.
risks: Reviewers may read it as pick-and-place with a lid, so the context must show the key and the bore clearance. The pedal-to-lid coupling is scripted in on_step because mechkit has no linkages, and it must not fight a gripper that is holding the lid. The 4 mm wire bail needs a graspable plastic grip. The loose 2.2 kg body may slide when the pedal is pressed (realistic, but tune its friction). All four parts are custom meshes, which fidelity must state.
self_review_takeover: 2026-11-16 Codex takeover of rate-limited Claude build. Strict audit: not Safety category—job task significance rests on returning serviced equipment to operation, with no invented injury proxy. Removed arbitrary slide/tilt/downward-speed failure gates. Found and fixed asymmetric notch collider segmentation. Lid closure threshold tightened to about 1 mm front clearance. Main remaining risk is collision-rich bail recovery: isolated pedal probe opens lid to 79 degrees but full recovery is not yet demonstrated. Not submission ready; all scores remain provisional until two fresh demos and adversarial validation.
